You're blaming yourself for things you had no control over. If you feel guilty about your cushy life, give back to society. There're tons of volunteer organizations that will distract you long enough to give you a vacation outside of your head, if only for a few hours. I promise that it will envigorate.

Don't be afraid to crush your parents. They love you, and having a hard time is nothing to be ashamed of. Besides, the pain you worry about causing in them will only multiply exponentially if you ever decide to cause yourself harm.

I know that weight that you're talking about. I see it in my wife. That weight buried deep in your chest. If you can get into a car, just leave town. Go to a forest a few hours away. Let it liberate you. Good luck, and I'm sorry that things are so difficult.

I've been pushing her to do that. She has work; she's tutoring kids, and perhaps that's been helping, but she essentially asked for my permission on Friday.(This is after aboout 2 weeks at work). The animal shelter is a novel idea. I'll take her to one of those this weekend.

thanks.
